words.gloss: to the extent that it is dug
to the extent that they learn

literal: To the extent dug, flows the sandy well; to people, to the extent learnt, flows knowledge.
translation: As water flows from a sandy well in proportion to the depth it is dug, so does knowledge flow to people in proportion to the depth of their learning.
modern: தோண்டும் அளவிற்கு மணற்கேணியில் நீர் சுரக்கும்; அதுபோல, கற்கும் அளவிற்கு மக்களுக்கு அறிவு வளரும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful analogy of a sandy well to explain how learning expands the mind. A well dug in sand yields water only as deep as one digs; the deeper you dig, the more water springs forth. Similarly, for human beings, knowledge springs forth and grows only to the extent that they study and learn. The key words 'தொட்டனைத்து' (as much as dug) and 'கற்றனைத்து' (as much as learnt) are perfectly paired to show the direct, proportional relationship between effort and outcome in education.
